label: Bible Study
prompt: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many _____ there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
verse: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
note: An ancient author warning about too many books — every student's favorite verse.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect _____.
verse: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
note: The path of the just is like dawn, shining brighter and brighter unto the perfect day.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a _____ by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
verse: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
note: Caught by his horns in a thicket: the ram that took Isaac's place in the land of Moriah, right on time.

label: Deep Water
prompt: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is _____.
verse: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.
note: The last words of Ezekiel name the restored city — after all the exile, its whole identity is God's presence.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Are not two sparrows sold for a _____? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
verse: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
note: Two sparrows for a 'farthing' — cheap birds, yet not one falls without your Father. Verse 31: you're worth more.
